content.value_statement: Engineering leaders need clear frameworks for architecture, metrics, hiring, and technical debt. This skill turns CTO planning questions into structured assessments, templates, and practical next steps.
actual_capabilities: Runs a local technical debt scoring model from provided system attributes.
Calculates team growth plans, hiring priorities, budget estimates, and scaling risks.
Provides ADR templates and examples for architecture governance.
Applies DORA, productivity, quality, and team health metrics frameworks.
Guides technology evaluation across technical, business, and operational criteria.
limitations: The calculators use simplified assumptions and example inputs unless adapted.
It does not connect to source repositories, metrics systems, or HR tools.
Recommendations need review against company strategy, budget, and legal constraints.
It does not replace executive judgment or formal security, finance, or legal review.

use_cases.title: CTO Planning Review
use_cases.description: Prepare a quarterly engineering review covering debt, metrics, architecture choices, and staffing priorities.

use_cases.title: Startup Scaling Plan
use_cases.description: Estimate hiring needs, management layers, and onboarding risks before expanding an engineering team.

use_cases.title: Architecture Governance
use_cases.description: Create ADRs and compare technology options with consistent decision criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Technical Debt
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess our technical debt. Ask for missing system details, then create a prioritized reduction plan with effort estimates.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Team Scaling
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a hiring plan for growing from 12 to 30 engineers over four quarters. Include roles, risks, and budget ranges.

prompt_templates.title: Create An ADR
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an ADR for choosing our API gateway. Compare managed, open source, and custom options using the provided framework.

prompt_templates.title: Build CTO Operating Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a board-ready engineering operating review. Combine DORA metrics, team health, technical debt, staffing, risks, and next-quarter priorities.

output_examples.input: We have 25 engineers and plan to reach 75 in four quarters.
output_examples.output: A quarterly hiring timeline, role priorities, estimated budget, management layers, communication risk, and onboarding recommendations.

output_examples.input: Our monolith slows delivery and lacks test coverage.
output_examples.output: A technical debt assessment with category scores, risk level, effort estimate, and the top remediation actions.

output_examples.input: We need to choose a monitoring platform.
output_examples.output: A technology evaluation plan with weighted criteria, proof-of-concept scope, risk assessment, and decision documentation guidance.

best_practices: Provide real team size, role mix, delivery metrics, and business constraints.
Use outputs as decision support, then validate assumptions with responsible leaders.
Record major technology choices as ADRs with clear consequences and review dates.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated budgets or staffing plans as final financial approvals.
Do not optimize one metric without checking quality, reliability, and team health.
Do not use ADR templates to justify fixed decisions without evidence.

faq.question: Can this skill run analysis scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes local Python calculators for technical debt and team scaling scenarios.

faq.question: Does it connect to external systems?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed files do not include network calls, repository access, or metrics system integrations.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is designed for CTOs, VPs of Engineering, founders, engineering managers, and senior technical leads.

faq.question: Can it replace a CTO?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured guidance, but leadership decisions still require business context and accountable review.

faq.question: What inputs improve the results?
faq.answer: Use current headcount, role mix, delivery metrics, incident data, budget limits, and target growth plans.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
